notes.title: New DLC announcement and contest/giveaway!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

On June 1, I will be releasing the ANIME MATCH HARD MODE DLC, which adds an additional 9 challenging cards and a new funky soundtrack to the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1651830/ANIME_MATCH__HARD_MODE/

To celebrate, I will be holding a giveaway for said DLC to increase participation in our vibrant speedrun community!

Official Rules

In order to participate and receive a copy of the ANIME MATCH HARD MODE DLC, you must complete and submit one run. Runs don't have to be for a specific time but must be recorded and publicly-accessible. Submit the name you'd like to be shown as on the board, a link to the video showing your run, and your time denominated in minutes, seconds, and milliseconds via exactly ONE of the following methods:


 E-mail me at miss ⭐ pasture dot moe (replace ⭐ with @)
 Send me a DM on Twitter: @MissPasture
 Send me a DM on the Fediverse: @pasture@pl.gamers.exposed


Event will begin on May 29, 2021 at 12:00 AM ET, and will continue until supplies are exhausted or June 7, 2021 at 12:00 AM ET. Entrants must not already own the HARD MODE DLC to participate. Steam-redeemable product codes will be delivered on or after June 1, 2021 via the entrant's entry method of choice and are valid until June 8, 2021 at 12:00 AM ET. By submitting an entry, entrants certify that their submission is their own and consent to the name they've chosen and video being shown on the boards at https://pasture.moe/games/runs. Miss Pasture reserves the right to reject or cancel entries if they are suspected to be in violation of these Official Rules. Failure to follow the Official Rules outlined in this post is grounds for disqualification and may result in revocation of any awards.

Have fun! I can't wait to see your runs!

notes.title: ANIME MATCH Update Released
notes.content:
An update to ANIME MATCH has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart ANIME MATCH. The major changes include:


 Removed nearly identical white bathing suit with blue polka-dot card.


If you wish to play the previous version of ANIME MATCH, switch to the "legacy" beta branch by doing the following:

[olist]
 Right-click ANIME MATCH in your Steam library.
 Click Properties...
 On the left side of the window that appears, click "Betas."
 Select "legacy - ANIME MATCH 1.0" from the "Select the beta you want to opt in to" dropdown.
[/olist]
